title: VANDIRA ECI Resource Parser & 403 Constituency Warehouse Contract
purpose: Provide a normalized constituency evidence layer and a live parser contract for official ECI constituency result pages without mutating canonical election or booth JSON.
source_rules: Official ECI result pages are the preferred live source for candidate-level parsing.
Local canonical snapshot is read-only and is used as the stable normalized fallback.
2024 Lok Sabha assembly-segment data is never promoted to 2024 Assembly election data.
Transient ECI backend download tokens are not persisted as permanent source URLs.
A parser failure is surfaced as a data gap; no candidate or vote is invented.
normalization_policy: AC number is the primary entity key; constituency name is descriptive and never used as the sole join key.
